title: OB-1
author: simonjohansson
description: OB-1, an SRC machine after the Oberheim OB-1's oscillator section. Work in progress: two VCOs, each with saw type (triangle to saw) and pulse type (narrow pulse to square) and a sub-octave, sync and cross mod, and noise, each mixed ON, -3 dB or OFF. Machine id 69.
